line: A moon-base AI wakes after forty years to a signal from Earth, and replies by drawing “home” in characters.
line_cn: 月球基地的 AI 沉睡 40 年后被唤醒，用字符画出“家”来回复。

camera.serves: a countdown; a queue; a log being read
one line of dialogue; a name; a decision typed
a title becoming line 1 of a list; one entry among thousands

camera.expresses: Hidden depth; what a symbol is made of
camera.serves: a letter made of messages; a pixel made of people
years of records; a changelog; a feed
a reboot; a new chapter; a crash

camera.move: Text becomes image (grid shrinks as glyphs fall)
camera.serves: a letter becoming a face; data becoming a map
a machine waking; an ending; a jolt

camera.move: Pull back off the glass into a drawn room
camera.expresses: The screen is an object in a world
camera.serves: who is reading; where the machine is

transitions: Transitions happen on the screen (clear, redraw, scroll, power), never a crossfade between two screens.
labels: Subtitles are terminal output. A reserved LOG strip at the bottom: a dim separator, an inverse-video tag, then a prompt and the line in uppercase at ~45 px. It is typed word by word in sync with the voice (whisper word timestamps) and holds ≥ max(1.8 s, speech + 0.6 s). It lives outside the zooming grid, like a status line, with the same scanlines and glow. When nobody speaks it can show system state (a progress bar, a waiting message).
On-screen text that the story shows is picture, not subtitle; in the .srt it appears as [SCREEN] ….
Titles are typed with key clicks, as a filename, a command or a header.
motion: Characters never move off-grid, except in a declared transformation moment. Typing, scrolling and counters jump from cell to cell. A roller flips digits discretely, fast then slowing.
Only three things move continuously: grid scale (the camera), CRT physics, and particles in a transformation.
Typing speed is performance: machine output is even and fast (~10–40 ms/char); dramatic lines slow to note values of the score; human typing is hand-timed, uneven, with pauses and bursts.
Particles spawn from random points inside source glyphs, start small, fade in, ease to their cell, and flash briefly on landing, so they never stack into bright bars.

native_moves.name: The picture is made of words
native_moves.does: A sentence breaks apart and its letters, sorted by ink density, become an image containing only those letters.
native_moves.fits: a manifesto becoming a crowd; a recipe becoming the dish; a poem becoming a landscape.

native_moves.name: Font size = camera
native_moves.does: Push until one character fills the screen and is itself made of smaller text.
native_moves.fits: a company name made of employee names; a year made of its headlines; a heart glyph made of messages.

native_moves.name: Typing rhythm = editing rhythm
native_moves.does: Even machine typing against uneven human typing; a blinking cursor is a performance.
native_moves.fits: a job application; an apology; a password remembered.

native_moves.name: CRT physics
native_moves.does: Power on as dot → line → frame, off to a dot; afterglow, bloom, curved glass.
native_moves.fits: a hospital monitor; a night shift ending; an old archive reopened.

native_moves.name: A single colour change
native_moves.does: One soft second colour appears once.
native_moves.fits: a first green leaf in a data log; a blood-orange sunset in a weather report; a child's drawing in a server room.

native_moves.name: The log file
native_moves.does: Timestamps, error codes, progress bars tell the story.
native_moves.fits: a product launch day; a rescue; a migration.

score.note: analog synth score, square sequencers, silence as an instrument
